text: docs/plan.md §2 has wrong counts for the VBA preposition lists: prps() holds 47 words (46 after the junk «g» is dropped), not 52; the complement list preps holds 16 words, and neither copy holds «без». Stopwords hold 439 words, not ~700; the same stray «g» sits in the stopwords literal and the build drops it there too. Source: RibbonCallbacks.vba lines 1322, 1374, 1426, 1428.
note: docs/plan.md already holds the right counts (prps 47/46, stopwords 439, preps 16 without «без»).
